name: penalise revisited levels to flatten the visit histogram
mechanism: keep a running estimate of how many states share each energy level; accept moves by the ratio of those estimates so frequently visited levels become less attractive, multiply the estimate of every visited level by a factor, and shrink the factor each time the visit histogram is flat; the estimate converges to the true density of states

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Wang and Landau algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Monte Carlo: an extension of Metropolis–Hastings algorithm sampling

fails_when: the modification factor saturates the error; flatness tests are heuristic
